name: Westfield MainPlace
description: Westfield MainPlace is a premier shopping destination in Santa Ana, California, offering an exceptional retail experience with a diverse mix of local and international brands. As part of the global Westfield portfolio, this center provides shoppers with convenient amenities including click-and-collect services, Smart Parking, and a wide variety of dining options from global staples to local eateries. The mall serves as a dynamic entertainment destination where visitors can shop, eat, and enjoy beautiful architecture while socializing with family and friends.
summary: Westfield MainPlace is a premier regional shopping mall in Santa Ana offering an exceptional mix of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences with modern conveniences like Smart Parking and click-and-collect services.
